;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2018 Minya bus attack]]
**Egyptian police kill 19 Islamist militants accused of involvement in an attack on [[Coptic Orthodox Church|Coptic Christian]]s in central [[Egypt]] two days ago. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-46090104 (BBC)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Ross Edgley]] becomes the first person to swim around Great Britain. The {{convert|1,780|mi|km|adj=on}} swim lasted 156 days. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-46088884 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 European floods]]
**Heavy floods affect [[Palermo]] in [[Sicily]], Italy, killing twelve people. The total death toll of the floods and strong winds in the country rises to 31 people. [http://www.teleacras.com/wp1/2018/11/05/maltempo-in-sicilia-12-morti/ (Teleacras)]
* 69.1 tonnes of C9 [[aromatic hydrocarbon]] are leaked into the ocean at a port in [[Quangang District]], [[Quanzhou]], China when a petrochemical company loads the cargo from its terminal into a chemical tanker and the aged hose coupling gasket breaks. Nearby [[aquaculture]] farms are contaminated, resulting in huge loss. Many fishermen and residents get sick from the leaked chemical, and 52 of them are hospitalized. Local authorities are accused of playing down the severity of the leakage. Discussion of the accident is suppressed on [[Microblogging in China|Weibo]] after the accident has become a hot topic. The company lies that the amount of leakage is 6.97 tonnes. [https://splash247.com/chemical-tanker-leak-causes-chaos-at-quanzhou-port/ (Splash 247)] [http://www.stheadline.com/inews-content.php?cat=e&nid=249229 (''Sing Tao Daily'')] [http://shanghaiist.com/2018/11/09/dozens-fall-ill-after-7-tons-of-toxic-chemicals-leak-into-water-near-fujian-fishing (Shanghaiist)] [http://www.globaltimes.cn/content/1128922.shtml (''Global Times'')]

;International relations
*[[2018 New Caledonian independence referendum]]
**[[New Caledonia]]ns vote against becoming an independent country from France. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-46087053 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*[[2017–2018 Spanish constitutional crisis]]
**The leading judge presiding over the investigation of the [[2017 Catalan independence referendum]] and the director of the [[Operation Anubis]] [[Juan Antonio Ramírez Sunyer]] dies suddenly at the age of 71. [https://www.elmundo.es/cataluna/2018/11/04/5bdebb68e5fdead3788b45ca.html (''El Mundo'')]
*[[Corruption in Ukraine]]
**[[Kateryna Handziuk]], an anti-corruption activist, dies of the injuries that she suffered in an acid attack on 31 July in [[Kherson]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-46091074 (BBC)]
*[[2011 Bahraini uprising]]
**[[Bahrain]]'s [[Judiciary of Bahrain|Court of Appeal]] rules that the former leader of the now outlawed [[Al Wefaq]] party, [[Ali Salman|Sheikh Ali Salman]], will receive a life sentence over his conviction for 2011 spying for [[Qatar]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-46088430 (BBC)]
